name: drivemate-driving-school
description: DriveMate Driving School Management System - Single Server Local Deployment

scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npx prisma generate
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
